item.title: Event Generation for Neutrino and Muon DIS at the LHC
item.description: arXiv:2610.16836v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neutrinos and muons produced in the forward direction of LHC collisions and detected by the FASER and SND@LHC experiments enable a comprehensive deep-inelastic scattering (DIS) programme. We systematically compare the predictions of NLO general-purpose Monte Carlo (MC) event generators for neutrino- and muon-initiated DIS at the LHC (Sherpa, Herwig7, and POWHEG) against analytical structure-function calculations (YADISM) and dedicated neutrino simulation packages (GENIE, NuWro, GiBUU). We quantify the role of higher-order QCD corrections, nuclear PDFs, parton shower and hadronisation modelling, and QED radiation.
item.dc:creator: Paulina Hernandez-Sainz, Felix Kling, Jelle Koorn, Juan Rojo

item.title: Neutrino Tridents and $W$-boson production at the Muon Collider
item.description: arXiv:2610.17263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Muon colliders are exceptionally intense sources of multi-TeV neutrinos, allowing even relatively small detectors to record large rates of neutrino interactions. We study neutrino trident production and on-shell W-boson production in neutrino-nucleus scattering.
item.dc:creator: Felix Kling, Toni M\"akel\"a, Sebastian Trojanowski, Bei Zhou

item.title: Implications for new physics solutions to the LSND and MiniBooNE anomalies after MicroBooNE results
item.description: arXiv:2610.17207v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The LSND and MiniBooNE neutrino experiments have provided statistically significant evidence of persistent electron-like event excesses. We study the consequences of recent MicroBooNE analyses for theoretical proposals and point out that a light dark neutral spin zero mediator with dominantly pseudoscalar couplings, decaying to an $e^+e^-$ pair, can account for the observations.
item.dc:creator: Waleed Abdallah, Raj Gandhi, Samiran Roy

item.title: Planck-Scale Constraints on Quantum Gravity-Induced Neutrino Decoherence with IceCube
item.description: arXiv:2610.14144v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a search for quantum decoherence using 368,071 atmospheric neutrinos detected by IceCube in the energy range 0.5-100 TeV. We find no evidence for decoherence and set the strongest constraints to date, improving on previous limits by over an order of magnitude for decoherence rate scaling as $E^2$ and $E^3$.
item.dc:creator: R. Abbasi, M. Ackermann, J. Adams, C. Arg\"uelles, S. B\"oser, J. C. D\'iaz-V\'elez

item.title: Concurrence Dynamics in Self-Gravitating Mixed Neutrinos
item.description: arXiv:2610.16508v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the entanglement generated by Newtonian self-gravity in a two-particle system of mixed neutrinos and quantify it by means of the concurrence. For initially separable flavor states the concurrence is obtained in closed analytic form.
item.dc:creator: Raoul Serao, Gianpaolo Torre, Antonio Capolupo

item.title: Octupole parton structure of spin-3/2 targets
item.description: arXiv:2610.17624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In spin-3/2 targets, octupole polarization can reveal quark and gluon correlations beyond those probed by vector polarization and quadrupole alignment. We construct the complete leading-twist gluon transverse-momentum distributions.
item.dc:creator: Brandon B. Le, Dustin Keller

item.title: Microscopic entropy of regular BTZ black holes in 3d Lovelock gravity at all orders
item.description: arXiv:2610.15917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give a microscopic derivation of the semi-classical entropy of the black holes of 3d Lovelock gravity with an infinite tower of regularized Lovelock corrections.
item.dc:creator: Hikmet \"Oz\c{s}ahin

item.title: $\chi_{c0}$ production in $\bar{\Lambda}n$ scattering process
item.description: arXiv:2610.14725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the production of $\chi_{c0}$ in the $\bar{\Lambda} n \rightarrow \chi_{c0} K^{0}_{S}$ process by utilizing an effective Lagrangian approach.
item.dc:creator: Quan-Yun Guo, Zhuo Yu, Dian-Yong Chen

item.title: Sensitivity of calibration-free DESI DR2 BAO--supernova constraints to a distance-duality tilt
item.description: arXiv:2610.16496v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent measurements from DESI baryon acoustic oscillations have reported a moderate preference for dynamical dark energy, challenging the standard $\Lambda$CDM paradigm.
item.dc:creator: St\'ephane Fay, Mikel Artola, Leandros Perivolaropoulos

item.title: Electron-Ion Collider as a Discovery Tool for Invisible Dark Bosons
item.description: arXiv:2505.08871v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We illustrate how the future Electron-Ion Collider can be used to discover dark bosons with masses in the 10 MeV - 10 GeV regime.
item.dc:creator: Hooman Davoudiasl, Hongkai Liu

item.title: Ab initio argon spectral function for the Achilles neutrino event generator
item.description: arXiv:2610.99999v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compute the spectral function of $^{40}$Ar and implement it in the Achilles event generator, including nuclear de-excitation via MARLEY. Quasielastic neutrino-nucleus cross sections are compared with MicroBooNE data. (synthetic test item)
item.dc:creator: A. Lovato, J. Isaacson, N. Rocco
